sinopsis.es: A los 75 años, Blanca sigue acompañando nacimientos en el Guaviare. En sus manos perdura un saber que ha sostenido a su comunidad entre la violencia y el abandono.
sinopsis.en: A story set in Calamar, a village in the middle of the Colombian jungle, where Blanca, a midwife by vocation, continues to bring life into this world. Her hands, the legacy of decades of service to the community, make her a guardian of life in a territory where violence, glyphosate, and neglect have left an indelible mark on the deep memory of its inhabitants. Together with Margarita, her friend and accomplice, we explore the profound relationship that destiny has bestowed upon them in relation to a birth.
